user.title: Add a new hamster
user.description: Let's start with some basic information about your hamster.

data_description.hamster_name: The name of your hamster. Used as the device name.
data_description.acquisition_date: The date your hamster moved in with you.
data_description.wheel_diameter: Diameter of the running wheel, as usually stated on the packaging or product page. If you're also using an ESPHome device for the wheel sensor, enter the same value there too.

sensors.title: Select source sensors
sensors.description: Choose the existing sensors and notification targets that should feed this hamster's device.

data_description.wheel_sensor: A sensor whose numeric state represents wheel rotations (e.g. a counter or pulse sensor) - a raw count that only ever increases, never a distance already converted to km. Using the bundled ESPHome firmware? Pick 'Hamster Wheel Total Rotations' - type 'Hamster Wheel' to narrow the list.
data_description.wheel_diameter_sync_entity: A number entity that should always match the wheel diameter entered above - typically the 'Hamster Wheel Diameter' entity on an ESPHome device. Whenever the diameter is set here (now or later, via Reconfigure), it's automatically pushed to this entity too, so you don't have to update both by hand. Leave empty to keep them fully independent.
data_description.temperature_sensor: A temperature sensor (device_class: temperature) placed near the cage.
data_description.door_sensor: A binary sensor (device_class: door or opening) that detects when the cage or lid is opened.
data_description.humidity_sensor: A humidity sensor (device_class: humidity) placed near the cage. Leave empty if you don't have one - no humidity entity will be created.
data_description.speed_sensor: A sensor reporting the current, real-time wheel speed (device_class: speed). Using the bundled ESPHome firmware? Pick 'Hamster Wheel Speed'. Leave empty if you don't have one - no speed entities will be created.
data_description.light_entity: A light that should turn on when the cage/lid opens and (optionally) back off when it closes - brightness, transition and turn-off behavior are configurable below. Leave empty if you don't have one - no light automation is set up.
data_description.notify_services: Notify entities that should receive alerts and daily summaries.

error.invalid_name: Please enter a name for your hamster.
error.invalid_diameter: Wheel diameter must be greater than 0.

init.title: Hamster Fitness settings
init.description: Fine-tune the health-score thresholds and the notifications.

data.weight_reminder_enabled: Remind me to weigh the hamster

data_description.ideal_temp_min: Lower bound of the ideal cage temperature range.
data_description.ideal_temp_max: Upper bound of the ideal cage temperature range.
data_description.min_distance_km: Below this distance run in a night, the health score drops sharply. Rated against the current night and the last completed one, whichever is higher - so the score never dips just because a new night has only started.
data_description.warnings_enabled: Turn off to silence immediate warnings (temperature, neglected cage, low score, too little exercise).
data_description.daily_summary_enabled: Turn off to stop the nightly distance summary.
data_description.notification_time: Local time at which the daily summary is sent.
data_description.weight_reminder_enabled: Only nags when the weight is actually overdue - if you enter a new value regularly, this reminder never fires. Sent at the daily summary time above.
data_description.weight_reminder_days: How many days may pass without a new weight before the reminder is sent.
data_description.light_brightness_pct: Only relevant if a cage light was selected in the sensors step. Brightness the light is set to when the cage opens.
data_description.light_transition_s: Only relevant if a cage light was selected. Fade duration for both turning on and off, in seconds. 0 switches instantly.
data_description.light_turn_off_enabled: Only relevant if a cage light was selected. Turn off automatically when the cage closes. Turn off if something else (e.g. an automation) should control when the light goes off.
data_description.light_turn_off_delay_s: Only relevant if a cage light was selected and automatic turn-off is enabled. Wait this many seconds after the cage closes before turning the light off. 0 turns it off immediately.

error.invalid_temp_range: The minimum temperature must be lower than the maximum.

warning.low_score: The health score has dropped to {score}%.
warning.too_little_exercise: Only {distance} km run so far, well below normal.
warning.neglected: The cage hasn't been opened in {hours} hours.

notify.weight_reminder: It's been {days} days since the last weigh-in.
notify.weight_reminder_never: No weight recorded yet - time for a first weigh-in?

pause_light_automation.name: Pause light automation
pause_light_automation.description: Temporarily stops the cage-light automation from reacting to the cage door, then re-arms it by itself. Handy while cleaning the cage, so the light doesn't flick on and off with every lift of the lid.

duration_minutes.name: Duration
duration_minutes.description: How long the automation stays paused. Calling this again replaces a running pause instead of stacking another one on top.
